categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Hi-Road Food Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of food ingredients for the baking and beverage industries. Its product portfolio includes dairy and plant-based cream products, chocolates, jams, sauces, frozen bakery items, and flavorings. The company serves baking, catering, tea beverage, retail, and industrial food sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technology-driven R&D with over 60 patents, focusing on plant-based and dairy fat innovations. It employs enzyme hydrolysis, microfine particle technology, and biological enzyme techniques to develop low-fat, low-sugar, and plant-based products. Production integrates digital transformation, mechanization, and automation to ensure quality and efficiency, supported by a strict quality management system.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large-scale baking enterprises, chain catering and tea beverage companies, food industrial clients, and retail distributors. The company targets both domestic and international markets, providing customized ingredient solutions and integrated supply chain services to meet diverse consumer demands for health, quality, and innovation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering most provinces and regions, with a growing presence in South Asia and Southeast Asia, including India, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, Turkey, and Russia. It has established multiple overseas subsidiaries and production bases to support global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Hi-Road Food Technology functions primarily as a midstream supplier and manufacturer of food ingredients, providing raw materials and semi-finished products to downstream baking and beverage manufacturers. It also offers integrated services including product customization, technical support, and supply chain management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes strengthening R&D capabilities by building advanced research centers and integrating AI and data-driven innovation. It focuses on developing health-oriented, plant-based, and customized products, expanding product lines in dairy cream, plant-based creams, jams, chocolates, and frozen bakery items. Strategic goals include enhancing global brand presence, optimizing product structure, expanding channels, and accelerating capacity building.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of food ingredients via a combination of direct sales to large clients and a buyout distribution model through over 900 domestic and international distributors. The company also leverages e-commerce platforms for online sales, though this accounts for a smaller portion of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the baking ingredient sector, competing with both large multinational corporations like Nestlé and Fonterra and local firms such as Ligao Foods and Nanqiao Foods. It differentiates itself through strong R&D, localized market responsiveness, comprehensive product lines, and a robust global supply chain network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.087 billion, a 13.89% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 110.79 million, up 23.78%. Total assets reached RMB 1.864 billion, with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. The company maintains a positive growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity and market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Hi-Road Food Technology emphasizes high-quality, safe, and innovative food ingredients tailored to evolving consumer preferences for health, taste, and convenience. Its competitive edge lies in patented technologies, product customization, integrated supply chain solutions, and commitment to sustainability and digital transformation, enabling it to deliver differentiated products such as low-fat, plant-based creams and stable frozen bakery solutions.
